review.assessment: The change standardizes transaction processing across all four statement renderers (`csv_out`, `html_out`, `json_out`, and `summary`) by replacing hardcoded equality checks for refund kinds with an inclusion check against `kinds.REFUND_KINDS`. This ensures that both full and partial refunds are consistently subtracted in every renderer, fixing the logic error where three of the four renderers were likely adding the partial refund amount instead of subtracting it.
